title: Vietnamese-Style Fried Cashew Nuts
description: A crispy and addictive snack inspired by Vietnamese street food, made with fried cashews and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the cashews and fry until golden brown, stirring frequently.
Remove the cashews from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Sprinkle the cashews with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Serve the fried cashews immediately and enjoy!
